text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult masculine fantasy ranger with long silver hair, a thick side braid and loose wisps, subtly pointed ears, gray eyes, pale skin, a softly angular face and muted rose lips. Silver dangling earrings, dark leather vest over a textured white shirt, understated silver jewelry. Thick braid falls over his right shoulder (image-left in front), dark brown intricately tooled leather fitted vest and ivory billowy open-neck shirt, embossed leather belt with antique silver buckle, charcoal slim trousers, dark brown knee-high ranger boots, empty hands. Tall lean athletic 190 cm, normal-sized face. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
